korean_evaluation.relevance: same existing canonical dish_family; weak proxy, not human semantic labels
korean_evaluation.duplicate_policy: one recipe per distinct encoded title per family; exact title duplicates excluded

model_selection: Choose one candidate from the predeclared grid using validation NDCG only, requiring Korean development Recall@10 above full V1 baseline; test remains sealed until candidate identity is recorded.
incumbent_note: Exact deployed V1 was trained through 2015-04-19 and early-stopped using data through 2017-02-21; its unbiased comparison window starts 2017-02-22 and has only five users with >=20 mixed-class candidates. Controlled V1 replications use the new shared chronological split.

validation_amendment.stage: after V1 validation baselines, before candidate training and any final test evaluation
validation_amendment.observation: full V1 validation AUC rose while user-macro NDCG fell
validation_amendment.candidate_loss: class-weighted BCE + 0.05 * softplus(negative_logit-positive_logit) on actual same-user ratings
validation_amendment.pair_sampling: five observed positive/negative pairs per training user, seed 42; no unknown negatives
validation_amendment.candidate_checkpoint: highest validation NDCG@10, patience 5; V1 replications retain original BCE-based checkpoint selection

validation_extension.stage: after four candidate validation reports, before opening any final test
validation_extension.observation: 0.05 pairwise weight improved user NDCG but substantially reduced global validation AUC
validation_extension.additional_grid: title weights .65/.30, Korean share .25, pairwise weights 0/.005
validation_extension.checkpoint_and_selection_constraint: validation AUC must meet full V1 baseline; then maximize validation user NDCG
